title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened strategic planning by disseminating the national strategic plan (2024-2029) and its operational plan, capacitated strategic planning units at the national and governorate levels on gender-responsive planning, and coordinating Egypt’s GPE membership. With MoETE and key stakeholders, UNICEF started the Out of School Children Initiative. UNICEF supported curriculum reform on: lower secondary curriculum; career guidance programme at lower secondary level; updating the curriculum for children with intellectual disabilities; and analyzing top-performing countries’ secondary level curricula. With MoETE and Administrative Control Authority, UNICEF designed a new leadership programme for aspiring MoETE leaders. Additionally, the teachers’ development system was developed.
